title: The Primer of the Early Waking Soul
summary: A primer for the rare cultivator whose soul has woken ahead of the body and learns to feel the first edge of its own reach.

title: A Primer of Reaching Outward
summary: A first course in pushing the soul out past the skin and counting the living bodies that lie inside its ring.

title: The First Listening Course
summary: A course in holding the soul still until the feeling of nearby people arrives unasked and can be read.

title: Handbook of the Steady Gaze
summary: A handbook on keeping the soul turned on one person for long stretches without drifting or tiring.

title: The Thread and Lantern Drill
summary: A drill that teaches a thin thread of soul to follow a target and a lantern of soul to light a whole room.

title: Plain Guide to Feeling Near
summary: A plain guide to sensing what stands within a few paces and guarding the sensing soul against rough touches.

title: The Quiet Mind Reader
summary: A reader on telling fear from calm from anger by the weight of a stranger's soul.

title: Primer of the Hushed Soul
summary: A primer on dimming the user's own soul so that its sensing goes unnoticed by those it touches.
